text: That seems like a significant amount of time; have you noticed any blood in your sputum, fever, or unintended weight loss? Also, do you have a history of smoking or exposure to secondhand smoke?

speaker: Patient
text: No, I haven't seen any blood, and I've had no fever or weight loss. I've never smoked, though I do work closely with children. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cushing's Syndrome (confirmed by elevated 24-hour urinary cortisol) presenting with chronic cough, likely due to systemic effects such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) or potential subclinical pulmonary involvement. DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Chronic Cough secondary to Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)
